name: socialync
description: Draft, schedule and publish posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Threads and Bluesky from Grok Build, with your approval on every post. Hosted MCP server with OAuth sign in, included on the Socialync free plan (X is on paid plans). Six skills: a post, a week of Shorts, a blog post into a week of posts, a weekly review, image carousels and the queue.
